meta.name: web-perf
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, or optimize website loading and interaction performance, Core Web Vitals, and Lighthouse performance scores.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并提升网站加载与交互性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让网页加载更快、交互更流畅
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and boost website loading and interaction performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want faster page loads and smoother interactions

howto.what: 用户提出检查或优化网站性能时，它会打开网页并记录加载过程，分析各项性能指标，定位拖慢页面的资源并给出具体修复建议，最后输出指标评级、问题清单和修改方案。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计、诊断或优化网站加载与交互性能，或提到 Core Web Vitals、Lighthouse 等指标时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个网页的性能：https://example.com
say.note: 它会打开页面并记录加载数据。

say.text: 我的 Core Web Vitals 不及格，帮我找出原因
say.note: 会分析 LCP、CLS 等指标给出诊断。

say.text: 根据审计结果，我该先优化哪里？
say.note: 会按优先级输出修复清单。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to check or optimize a site's performance, it opens the page and records the loading process, analyzes performance metrics, identifies slow resources, and gives concrete fixes, then outputs a report with metric ratings, issue list, and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to audit, diagnose, or optimize website loading and interaction performance, or mentions Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, etc.

say_en.text: Help me audit this page's performance: https://example.com
say_en.note: It loads the page and records performance data.

say_en.text: My Core Web Vitals are failing—please find out why
say_en.note: Analyzes LCP, CLS, etc. and diagnoses issues.

say_en.text: What should I optimize first based on the audit?
